title: Juicy British Ham Stir-fry
description: A savory and sour-sweet dish featuring juicy ham slices stir-fried with gluten-free-friendly vegetables for a nostalgic twist on classic British cuisine.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil or Gluten-Free Oil Substitute

instructions: Heat olive oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add chopped garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Remove from heat and stir in ham pieces. Cook for 4-5 minutes on each side or until golden brown and slightly crispy.
Return to the wok/pan with a small amount of sauce, stirring constantly to prevent sticking.
Gradually add remaining soy sauce, cornstarch mixture, and gluten-free veggie stir-fry sauce to the pan. Stir continuously to thicken and coat ingredients evenly.
Add any optional vegetables during the last 2-3 minutes of cooking time for a burst of flavor and color.
Cook until all the liquid is absorbed and flavors are well distributed throughout the dish.
